SELECT FROM agent ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent (app_id, name, config, status, agent_type, memory_schema, reference_turns, creator, create_time, updater, update_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{name}, #{config}, #{status}, #{agentType}, #{memorySchema}, #{referenceTurns}, COALESCE(#{creator}, ''), COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{updater}, ''), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, NOW()))
mapper.update: UPDATE agent SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE app_id = #{appId}
mapper.select: SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(update_time)) * 1000 FROM agent WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND status = 1
